name: Snap Layouts
description: Custom snap layouts for Windows 11: drag a window to the top edge and pick a region.
notes: Pinned to the v0.1.1 portable exe (GitHub pre-release, unsigned; SmartScreen warns). Other agents work on Region Control: never touch its local folder or its running process (contract 7.5). It owns its HKCU Run value RegionControl, so autostart is managed_by module. Its settings live in its own tray editor (layouts.json, theme.json in data_dir). Its own installer turns off Windows snap-on-drag and restores it at uninstall: the suite installer must copy that (contract 10.4). No stop event: the shell stops it only if the shell started it.
